style: Candid editorial nightlife photograph shot on a 35mm point-and-shoot film camera with hard direct on-camera flash: subjects crisp and bright, background falling off into deep black, slightly blown highlights, natural film grain, subtle vignetting, warm skin tones with coral-red and magenta accents from club lights, authentic and energetic, like a cool Gen Z party photographer's Instagram. Real-looking people aged 20 to 28, diverse, stylish casual outfits, genuine emotion and a bit of motion blur. Absolutely no text, no letters, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks, no drugs, no visible alcohol bottles. Vertical 4:5 framing.

decors.prompt: Three friends dancing and laughing close to the camera on a packed dancefloor, arms up, sweat and confetti in the flash.
Low angle on a DJ's hands on the mixer, a blurred crowd with raised hands behind, red light beams and smoke.
A group of friends laughing on a rooftop terrace at night, the bay of Nice and the Promenade lights glowing far behind, string lights.
A young woman with small sunglasses laughing out loud in the middle of a crowd, flash, hair moving, coral light rim.
A line of stylish young people waiting outside a club door at night, red neon glow on the wall, a bouncer silhouette at the entrance.
Beach party on a Riviera pebble beach at blue hour, people dancing barefoot, a DJ booth glowing in the background by the sea.
Close-up of dancing sneakers and feet on a dancefloor covered in confetti and light reflections.
Four friends squeezed on the back seat of a taxi at 4am, laughing, flash, city lights streaking through the window.
Wide view of a crowd from the stage at an open-air night festival by the sea, hands in the air, phone flashlights, laser beams.
Empty dancefloor with thick smoke and coral-red laser beams cutting through the dark, mirror ball, nobody in frame, lots of dark negative space.
Two friends clinking colorful mocktail glasses at a lively beach club terrace at sunset, golden light, palm trees, the sea behind.
A group selfie of five friends at a club, faces close together, big smiles, flash glare, some eyes closed, very candid.
